text:
lina: hey! first day questions  where's the canonical place to ask about VPN / MFA hiccups? also which channel should I use for "who stole my dongle" style hardware asks? :sweat_smile:

samir: welcome @lina :wave: VPN/MFA= #help for visibility, but if it's credential-related DM @it-support. Hardware pickup/returns -> #people-ops-hardware. short tip: include your employee id in the message so they can process faster.

lina: sweet. and for onboarding checklists that need sign-off by manager, should that be a thread or a new message?

it-support: Manager sign-offs: post the checklist in #new-hires as the root message and then @notify your manager in the thread. That keeps the feed tidy and lets People Ops track by thread.

lina: got it. last one: some bots spam a lot (builds, deploys). how do i avoid channel noise but still not miss important alerts?

ops-bot: Ops tip: use channel notification settings -> "Only @mentions" for noisy channels. For build/deploy bots, run `@deploys filter set team=<team-name>` to limit alerts. If you need a crisper feed, create a personal channel and `/invite @deploys` there for a filtered view.

samir: and reactions > "thanks" messages. if it's a small ack, just add :raised_hands: or :white_check_mark: so threads don't balloon.

lina: brilliant, thanks both! posting checklist now and will DM IT if MFA acts up. :tada:

onboard-bot: Thanks @lina  checklist received. People Ops will reply here within 24 hours if anything's missing.
